scenario.topic: Decide on the reward for winning the sales quarter challenge

options.name: Extra Paid Vacation Day
options.upside: Provides personal rest and recovery time.
options.concern: May disrupt team workflow if not scheduled carefully.

options.name: Gift Card to Popular Retailer
options.upside: Offers flexible spending options for the winner.

options.name: Team Lunch with Executive
options.concern: May be less appealing to winners who prefer privacy.

options.name: Professional Development Course Voucher
options.upside: Supports skill enhancement and career advancement.
options.concern: Requires time commitment outside regular work hours.

shared_context: The sales team will select one reward for the winner of the quarterly sales challenge. The reward should motivate the team and be feasible within the company’s budget and policies.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a senior sales strategist focused on maximizing team motivation.
personas.private_goal: To select a reward that balances flexibility with meaningful value.

A.reason_for: Provides personal rest and recovery time which can improve performance.
A.reason_against: May disrupt team workflow if not scheduled carefully.

B.reason_for: Offers flexible spending options and is a tangible, appreciated reward.

C.reason_for: Encourages networking and recognition which can boost morale.
C.reason_against: May be less appealing to winners who prefer privacy.

D.reason_for: Supports skill enhancement and career advancement, aligning with long-term goals.
D.reason_against: Requires time commitment outside regular work hours.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a pragmatic sales associate who values straightforward and low-disruption rewards.
personas.private_goal: To choose a reward that minimally impacts daily work and is easy to manage.

A.reason_for: Low cost and provides a clear personal benefit without complexity.

B.reason_for: Flexible spending is good but less direct than time off.
B.reason_against: Medium cost and less personal than other options.

C.reason_for: Networking is beneficial but may feel forced or uncomfortable.
C.reason_against: Medium cost and potential privacy concerns.

D.reason_for: Career growth is important but time commitment outside work is a downside.
D.reason_against: Medium cost and requires extra effort.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a direct and efficient sales rep who prefers simple, effective rewards.
personas.private_goal: To pick a reward that is easy to understand and clearly beneficial.

A.reason_for: Extra paid vacation is straightforward and provides real personal benefit.

B.reason_for: Gift card offers flexibility and is a tangible reward.

C.reason_for: Networking can be useful but may not appeal to everyone.

D.reason_for: Supports career growth, which is valuable long-term.
D.reason_against: Requires time outside work hours which may be inconvenient.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a motivated sales lead who values rewards that recognize effort without causing disruption.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the reward motivates while fitting within company constraints.

A.reason_for: Provides meaningful rest and is low cost, fitting company policies well.

B.reason_for: Flexible and appreciated reward with moderate cost.

C.reason_for: Networking is good but may not suit all winners' preferences.

D.reason_for: Supports professional growth which benefits both employee and company.
D.reason_against: Time commitment outside work hours may be a barrier.

acceptance_reasons.B: Gift card offers flexibility and is a tangible reward.
